title: Withania somnifera essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Withania somnifera essential oil is derived from the ashwagandha plant, a revered herb in Ayurvedic medicine. This oil is extracted through steam distillation of the plant's roots and leaves, capturing its therapeutic properties. It is known for its adaptogenic qualities, helping the body manage stress and promote balance. In herbalism, it is used to support immune function, enhance vitality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and fatigue. The essential oil is often applied topically or used in aromatherapy to harness its calming and restorative effects.
